name: stdConffile_Open

name: stdConffile_OpenMode
comment: Opens a configuration file through the file services (pFopen); pushes the currently open file first (stdConffile_Push) and allocates the 0x400-byte line buffer. The name 'none' means no file. Source file Stdconffile.c (C:\grimjedi\Libs\Std\General\Stdconffile.c).

name: stdConffile_Close
comment: Closes the current configuration file, frees the line buffer and pops the previous file if one was pushed. Source file Stdconffile.c (C:\grimjedi\Libs\Std\General\Stdconffile.c).

name: stdConffile_Push
comment: Saves the state of the open configuration file (name, line number, handle, line buffer) on the 8-deep stack so that another file can be opened. Source file Stdconffile.c (C:\grimjedi\Libs\Std\General\Stdconffile.c).

name: stdConffile_Pop
comment: Restores the configuration file state saved by stdConffile_Push. Source file Stdconffile.c (C:\grimjedi\Libs\Std\General\Stdconffile.c).

name: stdConffile_ReadLine
comment: Renamed from Std_ParseCommandLine: it does not tokenise a command line, it reads the next line of the open stdConffile into the line buffer g_dwStdConffile_aLine (skips ';' '#' and blank lines, strips '#' comments, lower-cases, joins lines that end in a backslash). Source file Stdconffile.c (C:\grimjedi\Libs\Std\General\Stdconffile.c).

name: rdCamera_OrthoProjectSquare

name: rdCamera_OrthoProjectSquareLst

name: rdCamera_PerspProjectLst

name: rdCamera_PerspProjectSquare

name: rdCamera_PerspProjectSquareLst

name: rdCamera_Free
comment: Frees a camera: its projection block and the camera itself.

name: sputRoom_LoadRoom
comment: Resource type 'SET ' loader (sputResource_SetHandler op 1): allocates the 0x1b08-byte set record, initialises it, parses the .set file, links it to the set-name entry and re-attaches the walkers of the actors already in that set.

name: Set_InitRecord
comment: Zeroes a 0x1b08-byte set record and fills the defaults (empty names, size field +0x1af4).

name: SetFile_Parse
comment: Remembers the set being parsed (g_dwLoadingRoom), stores its base file name (+0, 0x7f chars) and parses the sections with sputRoom_LoadRoomEntry.

name: sputRoom_LoadRoomEntry
comment: Opens the .set file with stdConffile and calls Set_IsHandleValid (the registered section handler dispatcher) for every 'section: <name>' line; returns 0 if a handler rejects its section.

name: sputRoom_ParseSetups
comment: Section handler 'setups' registered by sputRoom_Startup: reads 'numsetups', and per setup its name, background, zbuffer, position, interest, roll, fov, nclip, fclip (300-byte setup records at set+0xac).

name: sputRoom_ParseColormaps
comment: Section handler 'colormaps' registered by sputRoom_Startup: reads 'numcolormaps' and the colormap names (0x34-byte entries at set+0x80).

name: sputRoom_ParseSectors
comment: Section handler 'sectors' registered by sputRoom_Startup: runs ParseCollection for the set being parsed.

name: sputRoom_FreeRoom
comment: Resource type 'SET ' free handler: sputRoom_FreeRoomEntry, then frees the set record.

name: sputRoom_FreeRoomEntry
comment: Releases a set's resources, colormap array, setups and sectors and removes its actor list (killing the shadows of the actors in it).

name: Set_FreeSetups
comment: Frees every setup (300-byte records at set+0xac, count at +0xb0) and the array.

name: Set_FreeSetup
comment: Frees one setup: camera (rdCamera_Free), rdThing, and clears the pointer fields.

name: SetActorList_Free
comment: Unlinks a node from the g_pRoomList list (per-set actor lists, link at +0x84) and frees it.

name: Set_FreeSectors
comment: Deactivates the set's sectors and frees every sector in g_pWalkPlane_wp_head (Sector_Unlink + Plat_Free), then restores the previous list head.

name: Sector_Unlink
comment: __fastcall: unlinks a sector from g_pWalkPlane_wp_head and the per-type sector lists and releases its vertex pool entries.

name: sputResource_ColormapHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'CMAP' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = rdColormap_Load + 16-bit tables + pixel remap.

name: sputResource_FontHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'FONT' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = Text_LoadNativeFont, kept locked.

name: sputResource_KeyframeHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'KEYF' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = rdKeyframe_Load (default 15 fps).

name: sputResource_MaterialHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'MAT ' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = rdMaterial_LoadEntry, falls back to dflt.mat.

name: sputResource_ModelHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'MODL' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = rdModel3_Load (.3do).

name: sputResource_SetHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'SET ' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = sputRoom_LoadRoom.

name: sputResource_LipSyncHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'SYNC' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = grimSound_LipSyncLoad.

name: sputResource_ZBufferHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'ZBUF' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Load = sputRoom_LoadZBuffer (z-buffer bitmap).

name: sputResource_MemoryHandler
comment: Resource type handler for 'MEM ' (entry of g_ResTypeTable): op 1 loads, op 2 frees, op 3 reports the size. Plain memory block: free releases the block and its data.

name: sputRoom_LoadZBuffer
